data.body:
AC verification against merged tree (origin/main eba93991965, Gerrit 3257 MERGED, LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1).

Readable criteria (13), all confirmed in the two skill definitions:
- Two skills exist: examples/agent-skills/rebar-tidy/SKILL.md (153 lines, NEW) and examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/SKILL.md.
- rebar-tidy states "Admissible outputs are deletions and collapses only" as its one defining rule, with deletion and collapse each defined.
- "A run is capped at five tickets, each landable in one session" (frontmatter and body).
- Success metric: "A run is scored by what LANDED, attributed to the run -- never by tickets filed", with lines removed and mechanisms retired as the declared quantities.
- Measuring actor named: "The measuring actor is the next run, at its opening step"; step 1 of The pass is "Open by scoring the previous run".
- Not-merged visibility: "for each ticket that did not merge: that it did not, so a ticket that never landed is visible rather than silently absent".
- No new state: "This skill introduces no counter, no tag vocabulary and no persistent state of its own"; the run epic is "an ordinary ticket".
- No gates: "This run files no gates. Not as tickets, not as refinements of tickets", with addition-wanting findings recorded as ideas.
- SHA-scoped discovery with the 24-hour window: "Approval and ticketization must complete within 24 hours of that SHA; past that the plan is discarded and the run starts over".
- Atomic condensation: "A condensation is one atomic change or it is not done. Do not file per-file mechanical sweeps."
- Defect audit retained all four parts: Discovery (SKILL.md:40,:56), independent/blind verification (:41,:77,:84-86), prior-decision checking (:44,:89), one-at-a-time approval (:41,:44).
- Defect audit is not cleanup: grep -rni cleanup over examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/ returns zero matches; the frontmatter says "A defect audit, not a tidying pass".
- Vendor neutrality asserted in rebar-tidy Notes and proven by the test below.

Command and test criteria (4), all green:
- python scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py -> RC=0, "PASS: 5 SKILL.md file(s) have valid frontmatter." The new rebar-tidy/SKILL.md is auto-discovered by the glob and validated.
- tests/unit/test_janitor_concern_schema.py, tests/unit/test_skill_shared_sync.py, tests/unit/test_skill_vendor_neutral.py -> 12 passed in 3.20s.

make verify evidence is CI's Verified +1 on Gerrit 3257.
